Fantasy Tiles is a strategy game for 2 to 4 players aged 10 and up. Elves, dragons, goblins, dwarves, and other fantasy folk come together to bring to life a kingdom that is as colorful as it is coveted. Place your tiles in rows or columns—grouping identical or entirely different races—leverage existing alignments, trigger their powers, and seek out the most lucrative combinations to rack up the highest score!

—description from the publisher (translated)
community_text: [Rating: 9/10] I've played the game a few times in person and on BGA, and to be honest, this game is very addictive. I like that the game seems really simple, but it's extremely strategic. Every move matters. I also love the artwork on the game.
